uk.stay_back: 2 years Graduate Route for applications up to 31 December 2026; 18 months from 1 January 2027, with a two year grant announced in the 28 October 2026 Budget for graduates of high compliance universities (list, tests and start date not yet published); PhD graduates 3 years

abroad_note_add.uk: Budget of 28 October 2026: the government said the Graduate visa will be set at two years for graduates of "high compliance universities where there are strong labour market outcomes". It is a policy statement, not yet in the Immigration Rules: no university list, test or start date has been published, so the 18 month rule still applies to applications from 1 January 2027 until a Statement of Changes says otherwise. Plan with 18 months and treat two years as a possible bonus. The High Potential Individual route is to widen to graduates of the top 150 universities in the world. The international student levy of GBP 925 per student a year is confirmed for English providers from 1 August 2028 (first 220 students a year exempt); the university pays it, not the student, but fee rises are likely, and it does not apply in Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland.
abroad_note_add.us: Status on 11 November 2026: the USD 100,000 H-1B payment (Proclamation 10973, extended to 21 September 2027) is blocked by court orders in Massachusetts (8 June 2026, appeal pending in the First Circuit) and California (30 September 2026) and is not collected; DHS has separately proposed a USD 103,265 fee for cap subject H-1B petitions (comment period closed 24 September 2026). DHS has also proposed OPT fees paid by the school (reported as USD 70,000 for first OPT and USD 30,000 for later or STEM OPT; an earlier report said USD 100,000); none of these is in force. OPT today costs the I-765 filing fee, about USD 470. Rules can change within weeks, so check uscis.gov and your school international office before you pay a deposit.
abroad_note_add.de: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte, section 20a): up to 12 months in Germany to look for skilled work without a job offer, for a recognised degree or at least 2 years of vocational training plus 6 points or full recognition. Points: partial recognition 4, shortage occupation 1, 2 to 4 years of experience in the last 5 years 2 and 5 years 3, German A2 1, B1 2, B2 3, English C1 1, age up to 35 2 and 36 to 40 1, 6 months legal stay in Germany in the last 5 years 1, partner 1 (one page lists 2 points for partial recognition, four list 4). Entry minimum A1 German or B2 English; funds EUR 1,091 a month (EUR 13,092 for 12 months, higher than the EUR 992 a month for a student visa), shown by a blocked account, a declaration of commitment or a part time contract; application fee EUR 75; work up to 20 hours a week plus trial jobs of up to 2 weeks.

scholarship_note_add.s-sh: Status on 19 November 2026: the official stipendiumhungaricum.hu home page still said "Application is closed for the 2026/27 academic year" and its newest news item was dated 11 November 2026, so the 2027/28 call was not live yet; secondary sites expect it around 17 November with a 15 January 2027 deadline at 14:00 Central European Time, which is unconfirmed.

guides_add.name: Send tuition and living money abroad legally (NRB foreign exchange)
steps: Get the Ministry of Education no objection certificate (NOC) and keep the admission letter, invoice or I-20 and visa
Open or use a bank that offers the study foreign exchange facility and give it the NOC, admission letter, passport, citizenship and visa copy
Ask the bank for the tuition limit (reported USD 25,000 a year after the October 2024 NRB circular; older pages say USD 12,000) and the living expense limit for your country
Pay the 3 percent education service fee on the foreign currency released and send the money by SWIFT telegraphic transfer to the university account
docs: Admission or offer letter and fee invoice
Citizenship certificate and bank account details

faq_add.q: Which provincial Lok Sewa vacancies were open in Nepal in November 2026?
faq_add.a: Gandaki Notice 169/2083-84 for 75 Level 7 officer posts (48 technical, 27 non technical) was open to 2083/08/01 with double fee to 2083/08/08; Lumbini Notice 84/083-084 for 25 Level 9 posts closed on 2083/07/19 and the double fee date on 2083/07/26; Karnali Notice 14/2083-84 for 64 Level 5 posts closed on 2083/07/16 and 2083/07/23. Koshi had 69 competitive seats earlier. Check your own province site because each commission sets its own fee, dates and syllabus.

faq_add.q: What are the Gandaki Level 7 posts and how many seats does each have?
faq_add.a: Technical: Engineer 12, Agriculture Officer 9, Education and Section Officer (Education) 8, Livestock Development Officer 6, Veterinarian 4, Medical Record Officer 2, Radiography Technologist 2, and 1 each for Survey Officer, Nursing Officer, Medical Lab Technologist, Physiotherapist and Public Health Officer. Non technical: Administrative Officer 15, Accounts Officer 6, Revenue Officer 2, Internal Audit Officer 2, Computer Engineer 2. That is 75 seats in all, counted from the notice table.

faq_add.q: How much does it cost to apply for provincial Lok Sewa posts in different provinces?
faq_add.a: Gandaki Level 7: NPR 1,200 plus NPR 400 for each extra inter level or inclusive group. Koshi Level 7 or 8: NPR 1,200 plus NPR 400 per extra group. Lumbini Level 9: NPR 1,200 plus NPR 500 per extra group or post. Karnali Level 5: NPR 500 per advertisement, NPR 250 per extra inclusive group and NPR 200 per extra examination type. Late applications pay double during the grace week. Always read the notice because fees differ by province and level.

faq_add.q: Is the UK Graduate visa two years or 18 months for someone applying in 2027?
faq_add.a: The rule in force gives 18 months to bachelor and master graduates who apply on or after 1 January 2027, and two years to those who apply up to 31 December 2026. The Budget of 28 October 2026 said graduates of "high compliance" universities with strong job outcomes will get two years again, but no list, test or start date is published and it is not in the Immigration Rules yet. PhD graduates keep 3 years. Plan for 18 months until the Home Office publishes the detail.

faq_add.q: What is the UK international student levy and will I pay it?
faq_add.a: It is a flat GBP 925 a year per international student that English universities pay from 1 August 2028, with the first 220 international students a year exempt. The university pays it, not the student, so it is not a visa fee. Universities may raise fees to cover it, and it does not apply in Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland.

faq_add.q: Do I have to pay the USD 100,000 H-1B fee if I study in the US?
faq_add.a: Not as a student, and as of 11 November 2026 not even your employer, because court orders in Massachusetts and California block the payment and the government is appealing. A separate USD 103,265 fee for cap subject H-1B petitions is only proposed. DHS has also proposed fees on OPT paid by the school, reported at USD 70,000 first and USD 30,000 later, which are not in force. OPT still costs about USD 470 in filing fees. Check uscis.gov before you commit to a US degree on the strength of a work plan.

faq_add.q: What is the Germany Opportunity Card and can a Nepali graduate get it?
faq_add.a: It is a visa of up to 12 months to look for skilled work in Germany without a job offer. You need a recognised degree or at least 2 years of vocational training, 6 points (age up to 35 gives 2, German B2 gives 3, 5 years of experience gives 3, partial recognition of your degree gives 4), A1 German or B2 English, and EUR 1,091 a month shown in a blocked account (EUR 13,092 for 12 months). The fee is EUR 75 and you may work 20 hours a week.

faq_add.q: How much foreign currency can a Nepali student buy for tuition and living costs?
faq_add.a: Nepal Rastra Bank allows tuition, affiliation and examination fees to be sent abroad with an NOC and documents, reported as USD 25,000 a year after its October 2024 circular (older pages still say USD 12,000). Living costs sit under a country schedule: USD 12,000 a year for the USA, Australia, Canada and Europe, USD 6,000 for Singapore and South Korea, USD 4,000 for China, Malaysia, Thailand and the Philippines, USD 2,500 for Bangladesh and Pakistan and USD 5,000 elsewhere. Banks collect a 3 percent education service fee. Confirm the current figures with your bank.

faq_add.q: Has the Stipendium Hungaricum 2027/28 call opened for Nepali students?
faq_add.a: Not on 19 November 2026: the official stipendiumhungaricum.hu page still read that applications were closed for 2026/27. Secondary sites expect the portal to open about 17 November and close on 15 January 2027 at 14:00 Central European Time, but that is unconfirmed. Nepali applicants must also finish the national partner step before the national deadline, and need at least 56 points out of 100 at the university stage.
